---
title: "tb_colours"
output: html_document
---

Load tidyverse
```{R}
library(tidyverse)
```

Import tb data
```{R}
tb <- read_rds("data/tb_tidy.rds")

tb
```

Cloropleth map 
```{R}
# compute relative diff between 2021 and 2002 
tb_inc <- tb %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2002, 2012)) %>% 
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  spread(year, count) %>%
  mutate(reldif = ifelse(`2002` == 0, 0, (`2012` - `2002`)/(`2002`))) %>%
  ungroup()
# ifelse above means 'if country has 0 cases in year 2002, reldif = 0, else compute reldif using formula (2012-2002)/(2002)

tb_inc
  

```

Join with a world map
```{R}

# load maps
library(maps)
library(ggthemes)
world_map <- map_data("world")

# names of countries to the same in both data tables
tb_inc <- tb_inc %>%
  mutate(
    country = recode(
      country,
      "United States of America"="USA",            "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Irelan
d"="UK","Russian Federation"="Russia"
    ))

tb_map <- left_join(world_map, tb_inc, by=c("region" = "country"))

head(tb_map)
```

Sequential: Draw a map with sequential palette
```{R}
ggplot(tb_map) +
  geom_polygon(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = reldif)) + theme_map()
```


Modify colour palette of map
```{R}

# load viridis
library(viridis)

# plot map with color palette
ggplot(tb_map) + geom_polygon(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = reldif)) + theme_map() + scale_fill_viridis(na.value = "white")
```

Diverging palette
```{R}
ggplot(tb_map) + geom_polygon(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = reldif)) + theme_map() + scale_fill_distiller(palette = "PRGn", na.value = "white", limits = c(-7, 7))
```

Qualitative:  highlight each country by their continent using a qualitative palette as continents is a categorical variable
```{R}
# load country_continent
country_continent <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datascienceprogram/ids_course_data/master/country_continent.csv")

country_continent

# data preprocessing
country_continent <- country_continent %>%
  select(Continent_Name, Country_Name)
country_continent

countryName <- country_continent$Country_Name

# remove characters after (,)
country_continent$Country_Name <- gsub("\\,.*", "", countryName) 
country_continent

# rename countries for consistency
country_continent <- country_continent %>%
  mutate(country = recode(
    Country_Name,
    "United States of America"="USA",
    "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland"="UK",
    "Russian Federation"="Russia"
    ))

# map of countries highlighted by continent
tb_map %>%
  left_join(country_continent, by=c("region" = "country")) %>% 
  ggplot() + geom_polygon(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = Continent_Name)) + theme_map() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2", na.value = "white")
```

Color blindness colour palette (scales library)
```{R}
# load scales packages
library(scales)

# create fake data
df <- data.frame(x = runif(100), y = runif(100), cl = sample(c(rep("A", 50), rep("B", 50))))

p <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x, y, colour = cl)) + theme_bw() + geom_point() + theme(legend.position = "none", aspect.ratio = 1)

p
```

Color blindness colour palette (dichromat library)
```{R}
# load dichromat
library(dichromat)

clrs <- dichromat(hue_pal()(3))
p + scale_colour_manual("", values = clrs)
```
